changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingrefund AS SELECT br.id, br.refund_number, br.wallet_id, br.patient_id, br.encounter_id, br.original_payment_id, br.original_payment_transaction_id, br.refund_payment_transaction_id, br.refund_source_type, br.requested_amount, br.approved_amount, br.refunded_amount, br.reversed_amount, br.currency, br.refund_method_code, br.refund_method_id, br.status, br.request_date, br.requested_by, br.reason, br.approved_by, br.approved_date, br.rejected_by, br.rejected_date, br.rejection_reason, br.completed_by, br.completed_date, br.cancelled_by, br.cancelled_date, br.cancellation_reason, br.reversed_by, br.reversed_date, br.reversal_reason, br.external_reference, br.processor_reference, br.reference_document_type, br.reference_document_id, br.reference_document_number, br.original_refund_id, br.idempotency_key, br.transaction_group_id, br.notes, br.created_by, br.created_date, br.last_modified_by, br.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_refund br;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingrefund TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingrefund FROM report_user;
